title: Aromatic
summary: AROMAT'IC, AROMAT'ICAL, adjective Fragrant; spicy; strong-scented; odoriferous; having an agreeable odor. AROMAT'IC, noun A plant which yields a spicy, fragrant smell, or a warm pungent taste; as sage

inlines.v: AROMAT'IC, AROMAT'ICAL, adjective Fragrant; spicy; strong-scented; odoriferous; having an agreeable odor. AROMAT'IC, noun A plant which yields a spicy, fragrant smell, or a warm pungent taste; as sage, summer savory, geranium, sweet marjoram, etc.
